## Overview
> A volcanic archipelago of black-sand beaches, steaming vents, and jagged rock spires. Harbor towns cling to the edges of unstable islands while pirate clans fight for control of the trade routes threading between them. The air smells of sulfur and salt.

## Geography
- Dozens of volcanic islands ranging from massive calderas to barely-habitable rock outcroppings
- Warm tropical climate with unpredictable ashfall and occasional eruptions
- Treacherous reefs and strong currents make navigation deadly without local knowledge

## Known Settlements
- Ashport — largest harbor town, crossroads of trade and piracy
- Cinderhaven — fortified port built into a dormant caldera
- Reefwatch — remote fishing village on the outermost islands
